title: When does propagation of chaos in the critical Curie-Weiss model stop?
summary: We study increasing propagation of chaos for the critical Curie- Weiss model (i.e. the mean-field Ising model at critical inverse temperature 1, with no external field). We give a simple way to see that for windows of size k(N) of smaller order than sqrt{N} we still have propagation of chaos (reproving earlier results, see e.g.[1]), while for k(N) of order sqrt{N} the propagation of chaos breaks down.
